papers.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.

ai_summary.problem: 商用触觉传感器类型多样且物理特性各异，触觉理解难以摆脱传感器特定物理约束，导致具身模型难以有效利用异构触觉数据。
ai_summary.method: 提出触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch，学习跨压阻式、磁式和视触觉等传感器的统一触觉表征，并可扩展到新传感器类型；生成的触觉 token 可即插即用地接入扩散策略、π0.5 和 LingBot-VLA 等策略模型。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真和多种真实机器人硬件平台上的实验表明，该统一触觉表征能显著提升复杂操作任务表现，同时保持较强计算效率。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向异构触觉传感器的统一、可扩展且即插即用的触觉基础表征，使跨传感器触觉数据可用于规模化触觉学习。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中跨传感器触觉数据规模化利用和未来触觉硬件/具身模型设计提供了新思路。

papers.title: GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering
papers.abstract: In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/

ai_summary.problem: 超高分辨率遥感图像中，问题涉及的目标往往只有几个像素，现有的视觉语言模型（VLM）判断“看哪里”并直接采信所选视图答案的做法，在计数任务上会失效，而且这种失效与视图内目标数量有关，因此需要解决 VLM 在超视界条件下计数与方向关系推理不可靠的问题。
ai_summary.method: 论文先测得 VLM 的“计数地平线”（多数模型约 5 个目标），用幂律响应模型预测视图切分带来的漏计恢复与虚增，并据此只对超出该计数地平线的视图做切分。GeoScope 用纯文本语言模型把问题解析成带类型、可确定区域与分辨率的空间程序，VLM 只负责在其能力范围内定位和计数，方向关系则直接由定位框显式计算。
ai_summary.result: 无需训练，GeoScope 在 XLRS-Bench 上使 Qwen3-VL-8B 的区域计数提升 16.3 分、空间关系提升 10.5 分，并在区域计数和整体基准上取得当前报告的最高准确率（含训练方法）；在 UHR-Micro 上全局与区域计数分别提升 16.8 和 36.2 分，在 MME-RealWorld 计数上提升 11.4 分。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次依据实测的 VLM 能力上限（计数地平线）来决定是否切分超高分辨率视图，并用类型化空间程序把计数与方向推理从 VLM 的黑箱判断中解耦。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在高分辨率遥感与细粒度计数、空间推理任务中的可靠部署提供了可测量、免训练且可解释的范式。

papers.title: Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在视觉与文本输入相互冲突时，往往会依赖并非最可靠的那个模态，导致预测不可靠；论文要解决的是如何在推理阶段控制模型究竟听从哪个模态。
ai_summary.method: 作者识别出一小组对模态仲裁起因果作用的注意力头（arbitration heads），它们决定预测是跟随视觉证据还是文本证据；随后提出一种无需训练、轻量级的推理时干预，把指定为可信模态的偏置加到这些头上，实现双向的模态依赖控制。
ai_summary.result: 这些仲裁头在不同校准集规模下保持稳定，并能跨设置泛化；操控它们可在多个基准上有效双向调节模型对视觉/文本的依赖，使预测与任务指定的模态优先级对齐。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次定位到少量可因果控制模态仲裁的注意力头，并据此实现无需训练、即插即用的推理时模态偏好调控。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的可靠性与可控性提供了可解释、低成本的干预手段，对多模态对齐与安全部署有实用价值。

papers.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态智能体在长期交互中积累了大量历史信息，现有记忆系统通常只在压缩记忆上做语义检索并暴露固定的预定义表示，容易漏掉相关记忆，也无法适应不同查询对异构证据的需求。
ai_summary.method: 提出 HiVe-Mem 二维记忆框架：横向记忆扩展利用文本与视觉锚点把记忆片段组织成关系图，从语义检索到的种子节点扩展到相邻记忆，以补全信息；纵向证据组合让每条记忆保留摘要、描述、视觉定位视图、原始图像和交互历史等多种证据形式，再由轻量可训练选择器为每条记忆独立组合证据子集，实现按查询自适应地使用多模态信息。
ai_summary.result: 在三个多模态记忆基准上，HiVe-Mem 在不同基座模型上均稳定提升任务表现，同时相比最高效的多模态基线降低约90%的 token 消耗。
ai_summary.novelty: 将记忆检索从单一语义召回扩展为“图式横向扩展 + 查询自适应的纵向证据组合”，联合扩大记忆覆盖范围并灵活选择每条记忆贡献的证据形式。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态智能体的长期记忆管理提供了高效、可扩展的方案，对长程交互、具身智能和记忆增强型 Agent 具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model
papers.abstract: A world model predicts how a scene changes after an action, and a planner uses it to search for actions that reach a goal. If the camera moves or the controller changes, the same command moves the robot differently: when its commands are turned by 90 degrees, a frozen planner with the LeWM world model that succeeds in 77.5% of episodes succeeds in only 7.8%. Current fixes retrain the model, need training data, or forget a set-up when it returns. We propose Library of Hands (LoH), a training-free method that keeps the world model frozen and corrects only the map from commands to applied actions, which we call the hand. LoH reads the hand through the frozen model, with no extra sensor: it finds the action that best explains the change between two camera images (a reading). It stores every hand it identifies, so a returning set-up is recognised rather than re-learnt. In closed-loop tests, LoH more than doubles success on three simulated tasks, from 28.6% to 62.3%, and loses only 0.6 percentage points when nothing changes. It also works, unchanged, with two other world models and on two of three models pretrained on real robot data, and its gain grows with the quality of its readings.

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型在相机移动或控制器更换后失效：同一指令会产生不同的实际动作，例如命令旋转90度后，冻结的规划器成功率从77.5%暴跌到7.8%；现有方法需要重新训练、依赖数据，且无法记住已见过的配置。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Library of Hands (LoH)，一种无需训练的方法：保持世界模型冻结，仅校正从指令到实际执行动作的映射（称为"手"）。LoH 通过冻结模型从两帧相机图像的变化中无传感器地"读出"手，并将识别出的每个手存储起来，使回归的配置可被识别而无需重学。
ai_summary.result: 在闭环测试中，LoH 在三个仿真任务上把成功率从28.6%提升到62.3%（翻倍以上），在环境不变时仅损失0.6个百分点；无需修改即可适用于另外两个世界模型和三个真实机器人预训练模型中的两个，且收益随读数质量提升而增大。
ai_summary.novelty: 将适应问题从"重训世界模型"转化为"仅识别并记忆指令-动作映射（手）"，实现免训练、无需额外传感器、可复用已见配置的即插即用校正。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型规划器在具身智能中的鲁棒部署提供了低成本、可扩展的适应范式，避免昂贵的重训与数据采集。

papers.title: VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.

ai_summary.problem: 研究VLA模型在下游机器人任务微调时所需的数据量、训练更新预算、checkpoint选择方法，以及能否用仿真数据降低真实数据采集成本。
ai_summary.method: 在SO-101机械臂执行按格子名称移动国际象棋国王的任务上，用不同数据规模和更新预算微调π0.5，并结合遥操作真实演示与随机化脚本专家生成的仿真演示；同时比较验证损失、动作误差及多种改进训练策略。
ai_summary.result: 仿真中成功率随数据和更新量提升；短学习率冷却最多提升31个百分点且对checkpoint比较必要，验证损失和动作误差不适合选模型。真实机械臂上仿真预训练尤其能在真实数据稀缺时显著帮助；但过滤行为克隆、RECAP式优势条件、自动教练纠正和残差强化学习未带来可测提升。
ai_summary.novelty: 以精确操作与空间理解兼具的机器人国际象棋任务为案例，系统评估VLA微调中的数据规模、更新预算、模型选择及仿真到真实迁移，并报告负结果。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLA模型实际部署中的微调流程、数据高效训练和仿真数据利用提供了可操作的实证经验与警示。

papers.title: Beyond Sunny Skies: Using Large Language Models to Predict Urban Traffic in Adverse Weather
papers.abstract: Urban traffic flow prediction is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems, yet accurate forecasting under adverse weather conditions remains a significant challenge. Existing data-driven models, while effective for routine patterns, often struggle with the sparse data and complex non-linear shifts associated with rare meteorological events. These methods typically treat environmental contexts as shallow numerical features, failing to capture the underlying semantic reasoning-why and how specific adverse conditions alter mobility behaviors across regions with different functional compositions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.

ai_summary.problem: 城市交通流预测在恶劣天气等罕见气象事件下表现不佳，现有数据驱动模型难以应对稀疏数据和复杂非线性变化，且仅将环境上下文作为浅层数值特征，缺乏语义推理。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Multi-STG 统一框架，将 LLM 生成的语义先验与图时空学习结合：用 LLM 将天气、POI、节假日等上下文描述转化为语义嵌入，并通过多模态注意力融合机制动态加权异构输入，最后用带门控残差校准的语义增强预测头调整预测。
ai_summary.result: 在真实多城市私家车数据集上，Multi-STG 优于现有最强基线，三个城市平均 MAE 降低 11.82%，并在稀疏和非平稳条件下保持稳定性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 LLM 语义先验作为知识驱动补充，与图时空预测及门控残差校准融合，用于恶劣天气下的城市交通流预测。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明 LLM 可作为语义知识补充来增强时空预测模型，对数据稀缺和分布变化场景下的 AI 预测系统有参考意义。

papers.title: WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
papers.abstract: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视频世界模型评测多从单张图像或文本提示出发，且只关注感知质量与相机跟随，无法直接检验从视频出发探索动态世界时是否保持主体身份、事件演进以及重访同一地点时的场景一致性。
ai_summary.method: 提出 WanderBench 基准：包含 745 段真实与 AI 生成的单镜头源视频（3–25 秒、三个难度层级），配有以键盘动作表示的相机轨迹，并从 6 个维度、24 项经人工验证的子指标进行评估；同时提出免训练框架 WanderLand，让冻结模型生成的每一帧都以同一时刻的源视频帧为条件，并在重访时以自身早前生成的静态内容为条件。

papers.title: EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

papers.title: Prediction with Foundation Models under Deployment Budgets
papers.abstract: Foundation models can supply predictions for a downstream task that draw on knowledge from extensive pretraining, but they differ in task-specific accuracy and query cost. We develop a framework that improves prediction for the task under a budget on the average query cost per input, using training data to learn which models to query and how to combine their outputs with features available without querying. The first method queries the same models for every input; the second lets them vary across inputs and uses Q-learning to decide which model to query next and when to stop. For the first method, we show that several individually inaccurate outputs can jointly outperform the best single one. It attains the minimax rate when the regression function depends on the outputs only through models within the budget. Otherwise, any method within the budget can be forced to a slower rate, which the first method attains. For the second method, we show when varying the queried models across inputs strictly improves on querying the same models for every input, and bound its prediction risk and average cost in finite samples. In simulations and a multimodal laptop price application, both methods outperform existing methods.

papers.title: LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting
papers.abstract: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.

papers.title: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
papers.abstract: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.

ai_summary.problem: 探究有限的离散视觉词表能在多大程度上表征丰富的视觉世界，即如何构建一个通用的离散视觉 tokenizer，使视觉与语言模型能够统一到同一套下一 token 预测范式下。
ai_summary.method: 提出 dNaViT，一个原生分辨率的离散视觉 Transformer：在冻结的预训练编码器之上，通过轻量级残差调制和双分支目标，将重建感知线索注入语义特征；同时利用分组乘积量化（grouped product quantization）在不增加空间序列长度的前提下扩展离散容量，并配合平衡训练策略同时保留语义与像素级信息。

papers.title: Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis
papers.abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation. In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.

ai_summary.problem: 柏拉图表示假说（PRH）声称神经网络正收敛到相似的表示空间，但近期工作质疑该趋势在新一代语言模型上是否仍然成立，且表示相似度指标会受到模型深度与宽度的混淆，缺少合适的基线参照。

papers.title: DreamLander: A 6-DOF World Model based Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander
papers.abstract: Soft powered descent landings are becoming evermore important in the field of space exploration and scientific advancement, because of their ability to deliver mission critical payloads, both highly accurately and safely. The high efficiency restriction on planetary landings due to the severely limited fuel supply results in the need for optimal guidance trajectories and control. Model based reinforcement learning is proving to be an important tool in simplifying the highly complex process of generating optimal guidance trajectories and control. In this work, we present DreamLander, a state of the art model based reinforcement learning algorithm based on DreamerV3, to generate optimal guidance and control for a realistic 6 degree of freedom entry descent landing problem. The model based approach creates a sample efficient and highly generalizable model that can be applied to a variety of scenarios whilst maintaining a high degree of accuracy, landing within 2 meters of the designated landing zone, and with velocity norm less than 0.3 meters per second. DreamLander makes use of state sensor observations, making progress toward End-to-End solutions of the Entry Descent Landing problem.

papers.title: OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints
papers.abstract: Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day.   We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents.   We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.

papers.title: Scaling Taxonomy-Free Image Labeling with Generative AI: A Multimodal
papers.abstract: Providing real-time multimodal insights into images is challenging because it requires low latency, high description accuracy, and scalable solutions that are both cost-effective and efficient. For example, given a new image of an outfit, we would like to generate insights that the image depicts "earth tones" and "linen pants" and allow users to explore similar ideas along these themes. Traditional strategies to generate such insights would typically involve building taxonomies producing a golden set labeled by humans, training models on these datasets, and deploying these models for online inference services. Such workflows are constrained by fixed taxonomy, high labeling cost, limited labeling coverage in sample space, and human errors and expertise gaps in labelers. In addition, these methods are expensive and cumbersome to iterate over time. Recent trends have started exploring generative AI models for online insights, but this method suffers from long latency and prohibitive costs to support a high volume of requests or large amounts of offline labeling needs.   We present Generative Labeling On Clusters (GLOC) as a solution to provide highly scalable, cost-effective, low latency, and high accuracy online image insight services. GLOC leverages highly optimized image embeddings to form image clusters that are semantically close to each other for the purpose of the type of insights, and summarizes the insights at the cluster level, which effectively generalizes to members in the cluster. At Pinterest, GLOC powers image descriptors and pivot query suggestions for Hybrid Search, which is a multimodal search service enabling users to search with both an image and a text query. Our offline and online A/B tests demonstrate that GLOC significantly outperforms previous methods, delivering improvements in quality and efficiency.

ai_summary.problem: 传统图像标签/洞察生成依赖人工构建的固定分类体系和大量人工标注训练模型，成本高、覆盖有限、迭代困难；而直接使用生成式AI在线推理又面临延迟高、成本难以支撑大规模请求的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 GLOC（Generative Labeling On Clusters）：先用高度优化的图像 embedding 将语义相近的图像聚类，再在聚类层面用生成式AI总结洞察，从而将结果泛化到簇内所有成员，避免逐图调用大模型。

papers.title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.

ai_summary.problem: 医学影像视觉语言模型（VLM）通常只用准确率评估，忽略了答案、置信度和解释之间的一致性，而这直接影响模型输出是否可信。
ai_summary.method: 论文在乳腺密度和BI-RADS分类任务上，使用两个乳腺钼靶数据集评估四个VLM；通过对问题、多选题选项顺序和图像进行受控扰动，分析答案、置信度和解释三类输出的变化。
ai_summary.result: 实验发现：即使乳腺钼靶图像被改变，模型置信度也未必下降；打乱选项顺序会改变多数VLM的答案；部分模型中模型给出的推理会与最终答案矛盾。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统性地评估医学VLM在扰动下答案、置信度与解释之间的跨信号一致性，而不仅仅评估准确率。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了医学VLM可信性评估中准确率之外的盲点，强调需关注答案、置信度和解释的一致性。
ai_summary.org: Emory University

papers.title: GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery
papers.abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d_{\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.

ai_summary.problem: 针对底栖生物图像等专业分类领域，直接使用VLM仍受限，而视觉Transformer主要依赖低层视觉特征，缺乏人类识别所需的高层推理。
ai_summary.method: 提出GHiML流程：从VLM中提取以训练数据为条件的特定概念潜变量，生成基于这些变量的样本相关描述，再通过交叉注意力和逐节点门控路由器将文本嵌入与图像嵌入融合。还提出反向HML分数d_inv，用图遍历距离和基数惩罚评估层次多标签预测。
ai_summary.result: 在BenthicNet、FathomNet和iNaturalist上，路由器在域内底栖数据上将macro F1最多提升6.7个百分点、d_inv最多提升21.1个百分点，且在分布偏移下仍有增益。消融显示文本信号在多标签生物层次中主要影响预测基数而非节点判别，在单标签iNaturalist上移除文本会损失18.7%的macro F1。
ai_summary.novelty: 将VLM概念知识以层次多标签方式显式提取并融合到视觉分类中，同时提出更敏感的层次多标签评估指标d_inv。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明VLM蕴含可被激发的专业知识，可增强直接视觉学习不足的专业领域分类，并为层次多标签学习提供新思路。
ai_summary.org: Dalhousie University（根据作者推断）

papers.title: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
papers.abstract: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

ai_summary.problem: 无解码器的世界模型（如 LeWorldModel）仅靠隐空间前向动力学预测器和熵正则项学习可预测表征，但学到的隐嵌入结构约束不足，导致控制性能与规划效率有限，难以用于真实机器人的实时基于模型的控制。
ai_summary.method: 在 LeWorldModel 基础上额外引入两个隐空间损失：一个反向动力学预测器（由下一时刻状态预测当前状态）和一个逆动力学动作预测器（由状态转移推断动作），从而在不使用解码器的情况下对隐嵌入施加更强的结构约束。方法在标准世界模型基准和两个仿真机器人操作任务上进行验证。
ai_summary.result: 加入反向动力学与逆动力学预测损失后，隐空间结构更规整，在性能与规划效率上均优于基线，显示出更好的实时控制适用性。
ai_summary.novelty: 用反向动力学预测器和逆动力学动作预测器这两个额外隐空间损失替代/补充解码器，为无解码器世界模型提供更强的表征结构化约束。
ai_summary.relevance: 为无重建式世界模型提供了轻量、可提升规划效率的表征正则手段，有助于推动世界模型走向真实机器人的实时基于模型控制。
ai_summary.org: 提供信息中未给出作者机构（作者包括 Xinrui Zu、Michael Przystupa、Zhao Yang、Shujian Yu、Kevin Sebastian Luck）

papers.title: Smartphone-Enabled Depth-Aware Transillumination Imaging for Detection of Chicken Breast Fillet Myopathies in Chicken Fillets
papers.abstract: Woody Breast (WB) myopathy is a major quality defect in broiler chickens characterized by fibrosis, increased tissue hardness, and altered structural properties that affect product quality. Conventional palpation is subjective and labor-intensive, while many non-destructive methods require specialized equipment or substantial computational resources. This study developed a smartphone-based transillumination and 3D point-cloud framework for non-destructive WB severity classification. A total of 267 chicken breast fillets, including normal breast (NB, n = 87), mild WB (MWB, n = 85), and severe WB (SWB, n = 95), were evaluated using RAW transillumination images and 3D point clouds acquired with an iPhone 16 Pro. A total of 91 features, comprising 14 image-derived, 76 geometric, and one physics-informed Beer-Lambert attenuation feature, were extracted. Partial correlation controlling for thickness revealed a significant association between image characteristics and WB severity (r = 0.413, p < 0.0001), indicating optical information independent of fillet geometry. SWB tissue exhibited approximately 26% greater light attenuation per unit thickness than NB. The 2D-only models achieved approximately 82% test accuracy, while the multimodal ensemble combining Fusion-DGCNN, XGBoost, and physics-guided logistic regression (PGLR) achieved approximately 90% accuracy. These findings demonstrate the complementary value of optical, geometric, and physics-informed features and establish the feasibility of smartphone-based, non-destructive WB severity assessment.

ai_summary.problem: 肉鸡木质胸（Woody Breast）肌病会造成纤维化、组织变硬等品质缺陷，而传统的手工触诊主观且费时，现有无损检测方法又依赖专用设备或大量算力；因此需要一种低成本、可普及的无损分级手段。
ai_summary.method: 用 iPhone 16 Pro 采集 267 个鸡胸肉的 RAW 透射图像与 3D 点云，提取 91 维特征（14 个图像特征、76 个几何特征和 1 个基于 Beer-Lambert 定律的物理衰减特征），并用法向厚度做偏相关校正以剥离几何因素；再以 Fusion-DGCNN、XGBoost 与物理引导逻辑回归（PGLR）进行多模态集成分类。
ai_summary.result: 仅用 2D 图像特征的模型测试准确率约 82%，融合光学、几何与物理特征的多模态集成达到约 90%；重度木质胸组织每单位厚度的光衰减比正常组织高约 26%，且校正厚度后图像特征仍与严重程度显著相关（r=0.413, p<0.0001）。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将智能手机透射成像与深度点云结合，并引入基于 Beer-Lambert 定律的物理先验特征，实现低成本、可解释的木质胸无损分级。
ai_summary.relevance: 对 AI 领域属于应用型工作，价值主要在于展示了物理引导特征与多模态（图像+点云）融合在资源受限边缘场景中的有效性，可为物理信息机器学习与轻量化多模态感知提供参考。

key_lab_papers.title: EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth
key_lab_papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）被广泛用作图像编辑基准的自动评判器，但其可靠性缺乏系统审计；真实编辑图像缺乏受控的真值，且把指令要求的改变与模型伪影、意外副作用和模糊的成功程度纠缠在一起。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 EditJudge-Bench：1,382 对由 Blender 渲染的合成前后图像对，涵盖源自真实用户请求的九类编辑，并利用已知 3D 场景参数提供精确真值。由于每次编辑都是对受控场景的已知干预，该基准将 VLM 评判器作为“指令是否被正确执行的二值验证器”来评估，从而把评判器的感知能力与编辑器质量解耦。作者在 25 种评判器配置上进行了测试。
ai_summary.result: 审计发现显著可靠性缺口：广泛使用的 VIEScore 模板配 GPT-4o 仅达 69.0% AUROC；微调评判器为 51.7–66.3%；旋转、形状等空间编辑尤其困难；图像-文本顺序等提示格式选择可造成多达 14.1 个百分点的性能波动。尽管仅用合成数据，基准上的评判器排名与两个真实图像人类偏好基准高度相关（ρ=0.95 与 ρ=0.71）。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用可控 3D 渲染合成真值构建图像编辑评判器的诊断基准，从而在隔离编辑器质量的前提下审计 VLM 评判器本身，并证明合成审计结果可外推到真实评测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态评测与“LLM/VLM-as-judge”范式提供了可诊断、可复现的审计工具，揭示了当前图像编辑自动评判的可靠性上限与提示敏感性，对多模态基准设计与世界模型/图像生成评测有直接指导意义。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日研究几乎被多模态与具身智能/世界模型两大方向占满：一边是统一触觉表征、跨模态仲裁调控、离散视觉词表等基础表征工作，另一边是以 WanderBench、Library of Hands 为代表的免训练世界模型校正与评测基准。整体趋势是从「造更大的模型」转向「不重训也能插拔适配」，并密集出现带合成真值的诊断型基准。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日仅 OpenAI 一家大厂论文入库，方向为多模态大模型（VLM 图像编辑评判器审计），与其他机构无同向重合；其余论文均来自高校或未标注机构。值得一提的是，OpenAI 的 EditJudge-Bench 与今日多篇「诊断式基准」（WanderBench、跨信号一致性评估）形成方法论呼应，属互补而非竞争。
daily_insight.signals: 免训练、即插即用的适配方法集中出现（触觉表征、模态仲裁调控、世界模型手部校正、几何程序执行），显示「推理时调控/外部记忆」正成为替代微调的主流路线；同时世界模型领域首次出现探索动态世界的统一基准，评测基础设施正在补齐；图像编辑评测开始用 3D 渲染合成真值隔离编辑器变量，基准构建范式可能向可审计合成数据迁移。
